78666.subject: 💰 The Funding: What is the real test for DATs after the crypto rally?
78666.body:
The crypto rally has lifted DAT stocks, but the next test is whether they can generate recurring income and create value beyond simply holding tokens.

The Funding ( https://www.theblock.co/?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

Written by Yogita Khatri | Edited by Zack Abrams

The recent crypto rally has revived stocks of digital asset treasury companies, or DATs ( https://www.theblock.co/learn/390761/what-is-a-dat?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ).

I've covered DATs a few times in The Funding ( http://www.theblock.co/newsletters/the-funding?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) before. First, as venture investors backed bitcoin and altcoin treasury companies ( https://www.theblock.co/newsletters/the-funding/2025-06-01-why-vcs-backing-bitcoin-altcoin-crypto-treasury-companies-356489?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ). Then, as the sector raised more than $20 billion ( https://www.theblock.co/newsletters/the-funding/2025-09-21-crypto-treasury-funding-20-billion-peaked-whats-next-371536?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) and premiums to net asset value became a key part of the trade. Later, as the market fell, those premiums came under pressure and some companies turned to buybacks ( https://www.theblock.co/newsletters/the-funding/2025-11-02-the-funding-crypto-vcs-dats-buybacks-377187?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ).

Now the question is whether DATs have actually improved or are simply benefiting from higher crypto prices and renewed access to capital. I spoke to investors and industry participants to find out what matters next for DATs. Let's get started.

*THE INSIDE VIEW*

*DATs face a higher bar after the rally*

The recent crypto rally ( https://www.theblock.co/price?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) has also led to a rebound in the stock prices of digital asset treasury companies ( https://www.theblock.co/treasuries?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) , or DATs. Higher token prices increase the value of treasury holdings, improve balance sheets and can reopen access to capital. But is that enough for DATs to become sustainable?

The real question is whether DATs have actually improved on the original model, or are simply benefiting from higher token prices and issuance, said *Mike Bucella, co-founder and managing partner at Neoclassic Capital.*

Bucella said investors should examine which DATs are turning their treasuries into productive capital ( https://www.theblock.co/news/markets/2026-09-01-crypto-treasury-companies-hit-340-billion-market-cap-as-altcoin-dats-outperform-413142?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) by generating staking, lending, market-making or options income
